newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: Ivory Coast to investigate possible budget fraud.
newsitem.headline: Ivory Coast to investigate possible budget fraud.

text.p: The Ivory Coast government said it was refusing to pay bills for goods and services that had not been officially approved, and it was investigating to see whether fraud had been committed.
In a statement published on Saturday in the official daily Fraternite-Matin, the government said that 51.7 billion CFA francs ($82 million) of bills could not be properly explained.
It was thus cancelling the bills, although it would be setting aside contingency funds in case they turned out to be authentic.

The government said that public finances still remained in a fragile state because of the debt burden and "laxity", and that the decision to crack down on unsanctioned expenses was part of a wider effort to improve the management of the state budget.
